# GuestQueryHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.GuestQueryHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The GuestQuery handler class. Used to handle guest queries: messages that mention the bot in chats it
isn't a member of. It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_guest_query`](../decorators/on_guest_query.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when a new guest query arrives. It takes *(client,
  guest_query)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.
  The filters receive the [`GuestQuery`](../types/bots_and_keyboards/GuestQuery.md): custom filters can look at its *message*,
  while message filters such as `filters.text` or `filters.regex` don't apply to it.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    guest_query ([`GuestQuery`](../types/bots_and_keyboards/GuestQuery.md)):
        The received guest query.
